content.rationale: S3-read (qrwtzxpn) fixes the command — a file's contents at a named revision via `jj file show`; M-jj (zruxtxrv) fixes the crossing and its evidence-carrying runner; M-layout (szmuyqrq) places the module flat at src/jjread.rs. This maps the command to a machine-readable form and returns the file's bytes at that revision, so the store's read reads a document rather than jj's output; a failed crossing is carried as a value with its evidence, never rendered here (S3-err, uzzxlpsl). Which revision and which path the read names is S2-read's, not this layer's.
